annotations.title: List the import alerts this register covers

description: Which FDA import alerts are in here, and how many firms are on each? Returns the alert number, FDA's own title for it, the number of firms red-listed, how many countries they are in, and the newest listing date. Call this first to see what can be answered, and to get an alert number for list_alert_firms. Screening one supplier and would otherwise call several registers by hand? `screen_firm` at referencesource.org/mcp/screen answers this register and three others in one call.
name: list_import_alerts
title: List the import alerts this register covers
